definition_zh: 附加物；附属肢体；（贬）依附者；附庸
definition_en: a part or organ attached to a larger body, or a person treated as a lesser attachment
core_image: 挂在主体身上的附属件：螃蟹的钳、书后的附册、跟班式的人
scene: 解剖课的标本盘里，学生数着虾身上一节节的附肢。The lobster waved one appendage toward the glass.
sceneCN: 这里 appendage 是「附肢」（第 2 个义项：附属于身体的器官）；句意为：龙虾朝玻璃挥了一下附肢。

derivatives.zh: 词根动词，义为「附加；追加」
同根名词，义为「附录；阑尾」
加后缀 -ant，义为「附加的；随附的」

senses.title: A thing attached to something larger
senses.titleCN: 附属于较大物体的东西
senses.definition: an object or part added to and hanging from a larger whole
senses.definitionCN: 加在较大整体上并垂挂其下的物件或部分
senses.example: The old barn had become a mere appendage of the mansion.
senses.exampleCN: 旧谷仓已沦为宅邸的附属物。
senses.why: From hanging onto the main body, anything attached qualifies.
senses.whyCN: 从「挂在主体上」出发，任何附着物都算。

senses.title: A limb or organ of an animal
senses.definition: a projecting body part such as a limb, antenna, or claw
senses.definitionCN: 向外突出的身体部分，如肢、触角或螯
senses.example: Insects move with six jointed appendages.
senses.exampleCN: 昆虫靠六条分节的附肢行动。
senses.why: Limbs hang from the torso, the most literal hanging parts.
senses.whyCN: 肢体悬挂于躯干，是最字面的「挂着的东西」。

senses.title: A subordinate organization
senses.definition: a branch or unit dependent on a larger organization
senses.definitionCN: 依附于较大组织的分支或单位
senses.example: The research office is an appendage of the ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 研究室是部委的附属机构。
senses.why: Organizations hang smaller units from themselves like limbs.
senses.whyCN: 组织像长肢体一样在自身上挂出小单位。

senses.title: A person treated as a dependent
senses.definition: a person seen as having no independent status, merely attached to another
senses.definitionCN: 被视为没有独立地位、只依附于他人的人
senses.example: She refused to live as her husband's appendage.
senses.exampleCN: 她拒绝作为丈夫的附庸而活。
senses.why: The image of hanging transfers to people lacking independence.
senses.whyCN: 悬挂的意象转移到缺乏独立性的人身上。

senses.title: A superfluous extra
senses.definition: an addition that serves little purpose and could be removed
senses.definitionCN: 作用很小、去掉也无妨的附加部分
senses.example: Critics called the new wing a useless appendage.
senses.exampleCN: 评论者称新侧翼是无用的赘附物。
senses.why: A hanging part may dangle without function, giving the useless sense.
senses.whyCN: 悬挂的部分可能空垂无用，于是产生赘余义。

senses.title: A supplementary document part
senses.definition: material added after the main body of a text
senses.example: The appendices are technical appendages to the report.
senses.exampleCN: 附录是报告的技术性附属部分。
senses.why: Texts also grow tails, extending the image to documents.
senses.whyCN: 文本也会长出尾巴，意象因此延伸到文献。

senses.title: A legal accessory right
senses.definition: a right or property that legally attaches to another principal one
senses.definitionCN: 法律上附属于主要权利或财产的从属项
senses.example: The easement is an appendage of the estate.
senses.exampleCN: 地役权是地产的从属权利。
senses.why: Law formalizes attachment: minor rights hang on major ones.
senses.whyCN: 法律把附着关系形式化：小权利挂在大权利上。

senses.title: An ornamental attachment
senses.definition: a decorative piece hanging from clothing, a building, or an object
senses.definitionCN: 垂挂在衣物、建筑或器物上的装饰件
senses.example: Tassels are decorative appendages of the curtain.
senses.exampleCN: 流苏是窗帘的装饰性附件。
senses.why: Ornaments literally dangle, the most visual sense of hanging.
senses.whyCN: 饰品字面上就是垂挂的，是悬挂义最直观的体现。

intro.en: Appendage is append plus the noun suffix -age, first used in English in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: appendage 是 append 加名词后缀 -age，十七世纪进入英语。

items.en: The reconstructed root *(s)pen- meant to draw, stretch, or spin.
items.cn: 重构词根 *(s)pen- 意为拉、伸、纺。

items.en: Pendere, to hang, plus ad- formed appendere, to hang upon.
items.cn: pendere（悬挂）加 ad- 构成 appendere（悬挂其上）。

items.en: Appendentia and related forms denoted things attached or dependent.
items.cn: appendentia 及相关形式指附着或依附之物。

items.en: English built appendage on the verb append with the French-style suffix -age, denoting a collective or concrete product.
items.cn: 英语在动词 append 上加法语风格的后缀 -age 构成 appendage，表示具体的附着产物。

items.en: Today it names body limbs, subordinate parts of organizations, and people treated as dependents.
items.cn: 如今它指动物的附肢、机构的附属部分以及被视为附庸的人。

note.en: Appendage sits inside the pend-family and beside several attachment words.
note.cn: appendage 位于 pend 词族之内，并与若干「附着」类词相邻。

entries.definition: supplementary matter at the end of a book; a vestigial organ
to add something at the end
a jewel that hangs from a chain
an arm or leg of a body

normalIntro.en: Build appendage from append plus the familiar suffix -age.
normalIntro.cn: 用 append 加熟悉的后缀 -age 来拼记 appendage。

normal.en: appendage = append (add at the end) + -age (a thing).
Same pend root as pendant: both hang from something.
normal.cn: 与 pendant 同属 pend 词根：都是悬挂物。

normal.en: Biology anchor: insects have six appendages, i.e. legs.
normal.cn: 生物锚点：昆虫有六条附肢，即腿。

normal.en: Figurative anchor: a wife as a mere appendage is an outdated insult.
normal.cn: 比喻锚点：把妻子说成附庸是一种过时的贬低。

normal.en: Suffix parallel: attach → attachment, append → appendage.

abstract.en: Picture a crab raising its claws, each one a hanging tool.
abstract.cn: 想象螃蟹举起螯钳，每一只都是挂着的工具。

abstract.en: A tag dangling from a new suit — cut it off, it is only an appendage.
abstract.cn: 新西装上晃着的吊牌——剪掉它，只是个赘附物。

abstract.en: Appendage sounds like 'a penny age': a penny hanging from your pocket.
abstract.cn: appendage 听着像 a penny age：一枚硬币挂在口袋边。

examples.en: The starfish regrew a lost appendage.
examples.cn: 海星重新长出了失去的附肢。

examples.en: He resented being treated as an appendage of the committee.
examples.cn: 他反感被当作委员会的附庸。

examples.en: The old mill survives only as an appendage to the estate.
examples.cn: 老磨坊只是作为庄园的附属物留存下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿盆地基」——挂在「阿盆」底座边上的小部件就是附属物，谐音仅助记。

root: 拉丁词根 pend-（悬挂）：append（附加）+ 名词后缀 -age 构成 appendage，本义「挂着的东西」，既指动物附肢，也喻指依附者、附庸。

sensesIntro.en: From the image of something hanging on a larger body, appendage grows into animal limbs, subordinate units, dependent people, superfluous extras, document supplements, legal accessories, and ornaments.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「挂在较大物体上」的意象出发，appendage 生长出动物附肢、附属单位、依附者、赘余物、文献附属、法律从属与装饰附件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a part hanging from a larger body
core.cn: 核心意象：垂挂在较大身体上的部分

branches.en: things literally hanging on a larger whole, useful or ornamental
branches.cn: 字面上挂在整体上的物件，或实用或装饰
生命的突出部分：肢、螯、触角

branches.en: formal dependence: subordinate units and accessory rights
branches.cn: 正式的依附：附属机构与从属权利

branches.en: tails that texts and buildings grow, sometimes useless
branches.cn: 文本与建筑长出的尾巴，有时并无用处

intro.en: Appendage shows the productive pattern verb-plus-age for making nouns of action or product.
intro.cn: appendage 体现了「动词 + -age 构成行为或产物名词」的高能产模式。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin pendere, to hang, filtered through Old French -age.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 pendere（悬挂），经古法语后缀 -age 过滤。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「附加；追加」
同根名词，义为「附录；阑尾」
